_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/commander/test_command_zone.py. t_cz_courser is Hellkite Courser's printed line, whole -- the may, the put onto the battlefield out of the command zone, the haste, and the delayed return that is what `return_to_command_zone` exists for. t_cz_general is the legendary creature the position makes a commander, kept vanilla so the assertions are about where it is rather than what it does. t_cz_bear is a plain creature that is nobody's commander: it is how the op is shown to name the zone itself, since rule 903.9a would never send it there.

cards.name: Test Command Zone Courser
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may put a commander you own from the command zone onto the battlefield. It gains haste. Return it to the command zone at the beginning of the next end step.
